proposed.title: Prevent applyFieldOverrides from mutating shared field configs in nested frames
answers: Why does a panel using the Dashboard datasource inherit field display names or units from another panel?
Why are field overrides leaking into raw query results from Time series to table?
How to prevent applyFieldOverrides from mutating shared source DataFrame configurations?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Downstream panels consuming queries via the -- Dashboard -- datasource inherit unexpected display names, units, colors, or thresholds from an upstream table panel.
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/field/fieldOverrides.ts:applyFieldOverrides merged nested frame field configurations in-place with defaultsDeep, mutating shared query field objects.
Fix pattern: Deep-clone field configs before merging with defaultsDeep (defaultsDeep(cloneDeep(valueField.config) || {}, config)) and return new frame and field copies.
Constraints: Applies when processing nested frames (FieldType.frame) sharing field references; shallow copying is insufficient because defaultsDeep mutates nested objects like custom and thresholds.
proposed.applies: packages/grafana-data field override processing for nested DataFrame fields (FieldType.frame)

proposed.title: Preserve Dashboard datasource reference in v2 dashboard exports
answers: Why does a panel sharing another panel's query show Random Walk data after exporting and reimporting a v2 dashboard?
How are -- Dashboard -- datasource queries handled during v2 dashboard export?
Why are shared dashboard query results lost when exporting a dashboard with 'Share dashboard with another instance'?
How to preserve the Dashboard datasource reference when exporting v2 dashboards?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Exporting a v2 dashboard with "Share dashboard with another instance" enabled causes panels reusing another panel's query results to display Random Walk data after reimport.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts:makeExportableV2 treated the `-- Dashboard --` datasource reference as an instance-specific UID, stripping or remapping it.

Constraints: Applies only to the `-- Dashboard --` datasource reference during external export; ordinary datasource anonymization, other built-in datasources, and template variables retain standard export handling.

proposed.title: Widen database column to BIGINT when int64 alert rule fields exceed SMALLINT limit
answers: Why does saving an alert rule fail when missing-series evaluations to resolve exceeds 32767?
How to fix SMALLINT column overflow for missing series resolution counts in Grafana Alerting?
Can missing-series evals to resolve be set higher than 32,767 in alert rules?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Configuring an alert rule missing-series resolution count above 32,767 fails to persist on MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Root cause: pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go:AddAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve configured missing_series_evals_to_resolve as SMALLINT while the model uses int64.
Fix pattern: Add raw SQL migrations like pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go:ExpandAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve to alter the column type to BIGINT across MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Constraints: Applies when int64 model fields are persisted in narrower database columns; does not apply if the database column already accommodates int64 range.
proposed.applies: Grafana Alerting alert rule database schema on MySQL and PostgreSQL

proposed.title: Alert rule schema changes must mirror between alert_rule and alert_rule_version
answers: Do schema changes to alert_rule also need to be applied to alert_rule_version?
Why must alert_rule_version columns match alert_rule columns in Grafana Alerting?
What tables must be updated when modifying an alert rule column definition?
proposed.body:
Invariant: Schema modifications to alert_rule columns must be mirrored identically in alert_rule_version.
Enforced at: pkg/services/ngalert/store/alert_rule_test.go:TestIntegrationUpdateAlertRules
What breaks if skipped: Updating an alert rule writes a snapshot to alert_rule_version; if schemas diverge, rule updates fail on database insertion or truncate history data.
proposed.applies: Grafana Alerting rule storage and versioning schema migrations

proposed.title: Registering new SQL migrations in OSSMigrations and migration_ids.txt
answers: Where do I register a new database migration in Grafana?
Why is a newly added SQL migration failing migration tests in testdata/migration_ids.txt?
How to hook up a new ualert migration in sqlstore migrations?
proposed.body:
Mechanism: SQL migration runner registration in OSSMigrations and migration ID tracking list.
When defining new database migrations in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go:ExpandAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve, the migration function must be called in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/migrations.go:OSSMigrations.AddMigration.
What breaks if skipped: Each migration ID must also be listed in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/testdata/migration_ids.txt; omitting either prevents migrations from running or fails migration regression tests.

proposed.title: Ignore wildcard identity namespace when building OpenFeature evaluation context
answers: Why are feature flag evaluations rejected with a namespace mismatch when using a cluster-wide service token?
How does ContextHandler resolve the namespace for the OpenFeature evaluation context?
Why does a wildcard '*' identity namespace break OpenFeature flag evaluation?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Feature flag evaluation requests fail with a namespace mismatch error when callers authenticate using wildcard identity namespaces such as cluster-wide service tokens.
Root cause: pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler.go:ContextHandler.setRequestContext set the OpenFeature evaluation context namespace directly from the caller identity without filtering out wildcard '*' or empty strings, overriding instance-level scoping.
Fix pattern: Check that caller identity namespace is non-empty and not '*' before adopting it, otherwise fall back to stack configuration ('stacks-' + StackID) or 'default' to ensure evaluation context remains concrete.
Constraints: Applies when constructing OpenFeature evaluation contexts from incoming authentication identities; concrete non-wildcard caller namespaces must still take precedence over instance stack ID.
proposed.applies: Request context initialization when configuring OpenFeature evaluation context from caller identity.

proposed.title: Prevent excessive re-renders in useComboboxFloat from floating-ui autoUpdate and size measurements
answers: Why does Combobox inside collapsed details or Feature Control UI cause continuous re-renders?
How to prevent useComboboxFloat from re-rendering when floating UI size measurements do not change?
Why is autoUpdate causing DOM updates on closed or CSS-hidden Combobox inputs?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Combobox inputs in CSS-hidden or collapsed elements (such as Feature Control UI details) cause continuous re-renders and input DOM updates.
Root cause: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Combobox/useComboboxFloat.ts:useComboboxFloat ran autoUpdate unconditionally via whileElementsMounted and called setPopoverMaxSize with new object references on identical dimensions.
Fix pattern: Run autoUpdate inside a useEffect only when isOpen is true, and cache popoverMaxSize in a useRef to skip state updates when dimensions have not changed.
Constraints: Applies to floating components whose trigger or content is hidden via CSS rather than unmounted; does not apply when floating elements are fully unmounted while closed.

proposed.title: Aggregate apiserver introspection requires aggregated discovery format for CRD groups
answers: Why are CRD resources from an aggregate apiextensions apiserver missing during router introspection under /apis?
How does the router discover API groups from an aggregate apiserver supporting aggregated discovery?
Why does router aggregate discovery fail to see CRDs on baas_apiserver?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Resources and CRD groups served by an aggregate apiextensions apiserver fail to introspect and do not appear under /apis.
Root cause: pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:discoverGroups sent discovery requests without an aggregated discovery Accept header, causing targets like baas_apiserver to return only static startup groups and omit dynamic CRDs.
Fix pattern: Request aggregated discovery (apidiscovery.k8s.io) ahead of application/json, check the Content-Type in pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:decodeDiscoveryResponse, and decode APIGroupDiscoveryList into classic metav1.APIGroup structures via pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:apiGroupDiscoveryListToGroups with fallback to metav1.APIGroupList.
Constraints: Applies when discovering resources from aggregate apiserver targets that manage dynamic CRDs; does not apply to forward backends which read groups from RouteBackend CRs.
proposed.applies: pkg/router active discovery of API groups from aggregate apiserver targets

proposed.title: Prevent catastrophic backtracking in logs grammar key token regex
answers: Why does the logs panel freeze on long unformatted log lines?
How to fix catastrophic backtracking in log token syntax highlighting?
How should log-token-key regex be defined in logsGrammar?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Logs panel UI freezes or lags significantly when rendering log lines without key-value pairs during Prism syntax highlighting.
Root cause: public/app/features/logs/components/panel/grammar.ts:logsGrammar used (\b|\B) in 'log-token-key', which matches at every character position and triggers quadratic backtracking with (?=\s*=) on long tokens lacking an equals sign.
Fix pattern: Remove (\b|\B) alternation and anchor key token regexes strictly to word boundaries (\b).
Constraints: Applies to log token key regexes where keys begin at word boundaries (e.g., key=val); does not apply if valid keys can start with non-word boundary characters.
proposed.applies: Prism grammar token definitions for log highlighting in the logs panel.

proposed.title: Preserving valueRight across sandwich view tree transforms in diff flame graphs
answers: Why does the diff flame graph tooltip show NaN% or undefined in sandwich view?
Why are baseline, comparison, or diff sample values NaN in Callers and Callees view?
How should valueRight be propagated when merging or rebasing flame graph subtrees?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Diff flame graph tooltips show NaN%, NaNundefined, or bare undefined for baseline, comparison, or diff values in sandwich view (Callers/Callees).
Root cause: packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:mergeSubtrees and packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:getParentSubtrees rebuild LevelItem nodes for sandwich views without recomputing or propagating valueRight, which packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/FlameGraphTooltip.tsx:getDiffTooltipData dereferences with a non-null assertion.
Fix pattern: When aggregating or rebasing tree nodes for transformed views, sum or propagate valueRight alongside value if input items contain diff metrics, and default missing valueRight to 0 in tooltip calculations.
Constraints: valueRight should remain undefined for non-diff profiles (only set when at least one input node has valueRight !== undefined); applies whenever LevelItem nodes are rebuilt from existing trees.
proposed.applies: Flamegraph sandwich view and diff profile tooltip rendering in packages/grafana-flamegraph

proposed.title: MutableDataFrame length setter for strict mode object cloning
answers: Why does Explore raw Prometheus view throw TypeError: Cannot set property length of which has only a getter?
How to fix TypeError Cannot set property length of which has only a getter when cloning MutableDataFrame
Why does lodash cloneDeep fail on MutableDataFrame in Rspack ESM builds?
How to make DataFrame classes compatible with lodash cloneDeep in strict mode
proposed.body:
Symptom: In Explore, viewing the raw Prometheus view fails with "TypeError: Cannot set property length of #<d> which has only a getter" when running two or more instant queries.
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/dataframe/MutableDataFrame.ts:MutableDataFrame.length only had a getter for derived length, causing strict-mode lodash cloneDeep (used on merged queries in public/app/features/explore/PrometheusListView/RawListContainer.tsx:RawListContainer) to fail when reassigning keys.
Fix pattern: Add a no-op setter (`set length(_value: number) {}`) to classes whose derived properties are read and written back by generic object cloners, and remove unnecessary cloneDeep calls on read-only data.
Constraints: Applies to class properties with getters that generic cloners reassign in strict ESM environments; does not apply if writing to the property should actually update internal collection state.
proposed.applies: Grafana frontend data frame classes and Explore views handling cloned data under strict ESM / Rspack builds

proposed.title: XORM MustCols with In clause generates unsatisfiable zero-value predicate on Delete
answers: Why does annotation tag filtering still return tags that were removed from an annotation?
Why does xorm Delete with In and MustCols match zero rows?
How to use MustCols with an In condition in xorm without generating an unsatisfiable WHERE clause?
Why are removed tags not unlinked in annotation_tag when updating annotations?
proposed.body:
Symptom: Annotation tag filtering continues returning annotations for tags that were removed or replaced.
Root cause: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:xormRepositoryImpl.ensureTags included "tag_id" in MustCols alongside .In("tag_id", tagsDelete) on a bean with zero TagID, generating an unsatisfiable "tag_id = 0" WHERE clause.
Fix pattern: Omit columns with explicit .In(...) conditions from MustCols when executing xorm Delete with a struct bean.
Constraints: Applies when an explicit condition already filters the column; do not omit struct bean columns from MustCols if their zero value must be matched to prevent widening the query.
proposed.applies: xorm Delete calls combining MustCols with explicit In conditions

proposed.title: Denormalized annotation.tags must stay in sync with annotation_tag join table

Test placement: Integration tests in pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store_test.go:TestIntegrationAnnotations must verify annotation_tag via SQL directly because ItemDTO.Tags assertions cannot detect join table desync.

answers: Why is there empty dead space below an auto-fit panel with a short min height?
How to prevent auto-grid rows from reserving extra height when panel minHeight is smaller than rowHeight?
How does AutoGridLayout calculate CSS grid autoRows when fitContent is enabled?

Constraints: Applies when fitContent is enabled and fillScreen is disabled; does not affect layouts without auto-height panels or where fillScreen is active.

proposed.title: Preserve datasource type and uid in Explore trace link queries
answers: Why does Show context say No more logs available in Explore when clicking Logs for this span?
Why is datasource-specific log context UI missing after navigating from traces to logs?
How should query datasource objects be formatted in trace-to-logs and trace-to-metrics links?
proposed.body:
Symptom: In Explore, clicking "Show context" on a log row from a "Logs for this span" link falls back to "No more logs available" instead of displaying surrounding logs.
Root cause: public/app/features/explore/TraceView/createSpanLink.tsx:legacyCreateSpanLinkFactory generated inner queries containing only { uid } instead of { type, uid }, preventing Explore from identifying the datasource plugin.
Fix pattern: Populate both type and uid in the query datasource object ({ type: settings.type, uid: settings.uid }) when constructing Explore queries from datasource settings.
Constraints: Applies to inner query objects generated for trace navigation links; does not apply to top-level Explore pane datasource references which accept string UIDs.
proposed.applies: Explore queries generated by trace-to-logs and trace-to-metrics span links
